Use this as a baseline event-level relation when filtering by time, location, callsign, source, or measurement presence. | Use for: Filter observations by time range or geography; Compute summary stats for wind/sea-surface/pressure after unit conversion; Join observation-level data to other event datasets (self-join by timestamp/location/callsign)

icoads_obs_by_callsign_sequences_win.name: icoads_obs_by_callsign_sequences_win
icoads_obs_by_callsign_sequences_win.body_sql:
SELECT
  callsign,
  year,
  month,
  day,
  hour,
  -- construct an approximate timestamp (UTC-ish) from date parts and fractional hour
  TIMESTAMP_ADD(
    TIMESTAMP(CONCAT(CAST(year AS STRING), '-', LPAD(CAST(month AS STRING), 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(CAST(day AS STRING), 2, '0'))),
    INTERVAL CAST(FLOOR(hour) AS INT64) HOUR
  ) + CAST(ROUND((hour - FLOOR(hour)) * 3600) AS INT64) * INTERVAL 1 SECOND AS obs_timestamp,
  latitude,
  longitude,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(wind_speed, 10.0) AS wind_speed_m_s,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(sea_surface_temp, 10.0) AS sea_surface_temp_c,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(sea_level_pressure, 10.0) AS sea_level_pressure_hpa,
  -- previous observation timestamp for same callsign
  LAG(
    TIMESTAMP_ADD(
      TIMESTAMP(CONCAT(CAST(year AS STRING), '-', LPAD(CAST(month AS STRING), 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(CAST(day AS STRING), 2, '0'))),
      INTERVAL CAST(FLOOR(hour) AS INT64) HOUR
    ) + CAST(ROUND((hour - FLOOR(hour)) * 3600) AS INT64) * INTERVAL 1 SECOND
  ) OVER (PARTITION BY callsign ORDER BY year, month, day, hour) AS prev_obs_timestamp,
  -- seconds between observations for same callsign (compute diff between obs_timestamp and prev_obs_timestamp produced above)
  TIMESTAMP_DIFF(
    TIMESTAMP_ADD(
      TIMESTAMP(CONCAT(CAST(year AS STRING), '-', LPAD(CAST(month AS STRING), 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(CAST(day AS STRING), 2, '0'))),
      INTERVAL CAST(FLOOR(hour) AS INT64) HOUR
    ) + CAST(ROUND((hour - FLOOR(hour)) * 3600) AS INT64) * INTERVAL 1 SECOND,
    LAG(
      TIMESTAMP_ADD(
        TIMESTAMP(CONCAT(CAST(year AS STRING), '-', LPAD(CAST(month AS STRING), 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(CAST(day AS STRING), 2, '0'))),
        INTERVAL CAST(FLOOR(hour) AS INT64) HOUR
      ) + CAST(ROUND((hour - FLOOR(hour)) * 3600) AS INT64) * INTERVAL 1 SECOND
    ) OVER (PARTITION BY callsign ORDER BY year, month, day, hour),
    SECOND
  ) AS seconds_since_prev,
  -- spatial deltas
  latitude - LAG(latitude) OVER (PARTITION BY callsign ORDER BY year, month, day, hour) AS delta_lat_deg,
  longitude - LAG(longitude) OVER (PARTITION BY callsign ORDER BY year, month, day, hour) AS delta_lon_deg,
  -- variable deltas (apply SAFE_DIVIDE consistently and avoid nesting analytic functions)
  SAFE_DIVIDE(wind_speed, 10.0) - LAG(SAFE_DIVIDE(wind_speed, 10.0)) OVER (PARTITION BY callsign ORDER BY year, month, day, hour) AS delta_wind_speed_m_s,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(sea_surface_temp, 10.0) - LAG(SAFE_DIVIDE(sea_surface_temp, 10.0)) OVER (PARTITION BY callsign ORDER BY year, month, day, hour) AS delta_sea_surface_temp_c,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(sea_level_pressure, 10.0) - LAG(SAFE_DIVIDE(sea_level_pressure, 10.0)) OVER (PARTITION BY callsign ORDER BY year, month, day, hour) AS delta_sea_level_pressure_hpa,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY callsign ORDER BY year, month, day, hour) AS obs_number_for_callsign
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2001_2004`
grain: one row per observation per callsign with windowed differences to previous observation of same callsign

semantic_filters.callsign: rows may have NULL callsign; caller may filter to non-null callsign if sequences per platform are desired

params.description: Provides one row per ICAO/Icoads observation per callsign with an approximate UTC timestamp and windowed differences (time and value deltas) to the previous observation of the same callsign.
params.when_to_use: Compute time gaps and per-observation deltas (latitude, longitude, wind speed, sea surface temperature, sea level pressure) between consecutive observations of the same callsign. | Build track/sequence analytics per platform/callsign (speed estimation, temporal sampling analysis, sequence ordering) where you need the prior-observation context. | Filter observations by time, location, or delta thresholds before aggregating (e.g., identify long gaps, large jumps, or rapid changes per callsign). | Join observational rows to other dimension tables by callsign or time for enrichment while preserving one-row-per-observation semantics.
params.output_schema: callsign: The reporting platform identifier (directly from base column callsign). | year: Observation year (directly from base column year). | month: Observation month (directly from base column month). | day: Observation day of month (directly from base column day). | hour: Observation hour expressed as a fractional hour value (directly from base column hour). | obs_timestamp: Approximate UTC timestamp constructed from year, month, day and hour (expression built from year, month, day, hour; see grounded_columns for exact expression). | latitude: Observation latitude in decimal degrees (directly from base column latitude). | longitude: Observation longitude in decimal degrees (directly from base column longitude). | wind_speed_m_s: Wind speed for the observation in meters per second = SAFE_DIVIDE(wind_speed, 10.0) where wind_speed is the raw stored integer/decitunits. | sea_surface_temp_c: Sea surface temperature in degrees Celsius = SAFE_DIVIDE(sea_surface_temp, 10.0) where sea_surface_temp is the raw stored integer/decitunits. | sea_level_pressure_hpa: Sea level pressure in hPa = SAFE_DIVIDE(sea_level_pressure, 10.0) where sea_level_pressure is the raw stored integer/decitunits. | prev_obs_timestamp: The obs_timestamp of the previous observation for the same callsign (LAG over PARTITION BY callsign ORDER BY year, month, day, hour). | seconds_since_prev: Time difference in seconds between obs_timestamp and prev_obs_timestamp (TIMESTAMP_DIFF using the constructed timestamps). | delta_lat_deg: Latitude difference (latitude - latitude_of_previous_observation_for_same_callsign). Computed via difference between the current latitude column and the lagged latitude value implied by the window (the view computes timestamp lag; callers should infer analogous lag for lat if needed — see grounded_columns). | delta_lon_deg: Longitude difference (longitude - longitude_of_previous_observation_for_same_callsign). | delta_wind_speed_m_s: Change in wind_speed_m_s between this observation and the previous one for the same callsign (current SAFE_DIVIDE(wind_speed,10.0) minus previous SAFE_DIVIDE(wind_speed,10.0)). | delta_sea_surface_temp_c: Change in sea_surface_temp_c between this observation and the previous one for the same callsign. | delta_sea_level_pressure_hpa: Change in sea_level_pressure_hpa between this observation and the previous one for the same callsign. | obs_number_for_callsign: Sequential row number for this callsign ordered by year, month, day, hour (i.e., the index of this observation within the callsign's sequence).
params.grounded_columns: icoads_observations_raw.callsign (referenced as callsign in SQL) | icoads_observations_raw.year (referenced as year in SQL) | icoads_observations_raw.month (referenced as month in SQL) | icoads_observations_raw.day (referenced as day in SQL) | icoads_observations_raw.hour (referenced as hour in SQL) | icoads_observations_raw.latitude (referenced as latitude in SQL) | icoads_observations_raw.longitude (referenced as longitude in SQL) | icoads_observations_raw.wind_speed (referenced as wind_speed in SQL and converted to wind_speed_m_s) | icoads_observations_raw.sea_surface_temp (referenced as sea_surface_temp in SQL and converted to sea_surface_temp_c) | icoads_observations_raw.sea_level_pressure (referenced as sea_level_pressure in SQL and converted to sea_level_pressure_hpa)
params.metric: obs_timestamp = TIMESTAMP_ADD(TIMESTAMP(CONCAT(CAST(year AS STRING), '-', LPAD(CAST(month AS STRING),2,'0'), '-', LPAD(CAST(day AS STRING),2,'0'))), INTERVAL CAST(FLOOR(hour) AS INT64) HOUR) + CAST(ROUND((hour - FLOOR(hour)) * 3600) AS INT64) * INTERVAL 1 SECOND | wind_speed_m_s = SAFE_DIVIDE(wind_speed, 10.0) | sea_surface_temp_c = SAFE_DIVIDE(sea_surface_temp, 10.0) | sea_level_pressure_hpa = SAFE_DIVIDE(sea_level_pressure, 10.0) | prev_obs_timestamp = LAG(obs_timestamp) OVER (PARTITION BY callsign ORDER BY year, month, day, hour) | seconds_since_prev = TIMESTAMP_DIFF(obs_timestamp, prev_obs_timestamp, SECOND) | delta_lat_deg = latitude - LAG(latitude) OVER (PARTITION BY callsign ORDER BY year, month, day, hour) | delta_lon_deg = longitude - LAG(longitude) OVER (PARTITION BY callsign ORDER BY year, month, day, hour) | delta_wind_speed_m_s = wind_speed_m_s - LAG(wind_speed_m_s) OVER (PARTITION BY callsign ORDER BY year, month, day, hour) | delta_sea_surface_temp_c = sea_surface_temp_c - LAG(sea_surface_temp_c) OVER (PARTITION BY callsign ORDER BY year, month, day, hour) | delta_sea_level_pressure_hpa = sea_level_pressure_hpa - LAG(sea_level_pressure_hpa) OVER (PARTITION BY callsign ORDER BY year, month, day, hour) | obs_number_for_callsign = ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY callsign ORDER BY year, month, day, hour)
params.composition: cardinality-SAFE join guidance: join to a one-row-per-callsign dimension (e.g., stations_dim on stations_dim.callsign = icoads_obs_by_callsign_sequences_win.callsign) — safe because this view is already one row per observation and the dimension is one row per callsign, so measures are not duplicated. | cardinality-SAFE join guidance: join to time/date dimensions on computed obs_timestamp (e.g., date_dim.date = DATE(obs_timestamp)) — safe when the dimension is one-row-per-date or one-row-per-hour; the observation row remains unique. | do NOT join directly to any one-to-many table or view without re-aggregation (examples in this dataset: icoads_monthly_agg_per_box (AGG) if expanded into many boxes, ship_observation sequences, or any raw event tables that contain multiple rows per observation) because joining a one-to-many child will multiply rows and duplicate per-observation deltas and counts. If you need attributes from a one-to-many table, first aggregate that table to one row per callsign+obs_timestamp (or per callsign) before joining. | do NOT join to views that contain additional per-observation sequences or windows (e.g., ship_observation_sequences_win or storm_observation_deltas_win) without aligning the partition/order keys — such joins risk creating many-to-many matches across sequence rows and duplicating measures. Instead, join on exact keys (callsign + obs_timestamp) or pre-aggregate to one row per callsign+obs_timestamp. | when composing aggregates: if you aggregate this view (for example, COUNT(*) or AVG(delta_wind_speed_m_s) per callsign or per day), perform aggregation after any join to avoid accidental multiplication; prefer subquery or CTE where this view is first deduplicated to its natural grain (one row per observation) before joining to multi-row tables.

icoads_obs_by_callsign_sequences_win.description: Creates an observation-level sequence per callsign (ship/station identifier) with timestamps and windowed differences to the previous observation for the same callsign. Useful for computing movement, observation frequency, and short-term deltas in measured variables per platform. | Use for: Compute vessel/platform movement speed and direction between successive observations; Filter sequences by observation gap (e.g., where seconds_since_prev <= some threshold); Calculate per-callsign time series summaries or rolling means

icoads_top_observations_rank_by_box.name: icoads_top_observations_rank_by_box
icoads_top_observations_rank_by_box.body_sql:
SELECT
  year,
  month,
  ten_degree_box_number,
  one_degree_box_number,
  latitude,
  longitude,
  callsign,
  deck,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(wind_speed,10.0) AS wind_speed_m_s,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(sea_surface_temp,10.0) AS sea_surface_temp_c,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(sea_level_pressure,10.0) AS sea_level_pressure_hpa,
  RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY year, ten_degree_box_number, one_degree_box_number ORDER BY SAFE_DIVIDE(wind_speed,10.0) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rank_by_wind_speed_desc,
  RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY year, ten_degree_box_number, one_degree_box_number ORDER BY SAFE_DIVIDE(sea_surface_temp,10.0) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rank_by_sst_desc,
  RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY year, ten_degree_box_number, one_degree_box_number ORDER BY SAFE_DIVIDE(sea_level_pressure,10.0) ASC NULLS LAST) AS rank_by_slp_asc
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2001_2004`
grain: one row per original observation with ranks assigned within year + box partitions

semantic_filters.none: no intrinsic filters; downstream queries typically filter WHERE rank_by_* <= K

params.description: For each original ICOADS observation (one row per observation) this view returns location/time, selected meteorological measures converted to human units, and intra-year+box ranks of each observation by wind speed (descending), sea surface temperature (descending) and sea level pressure (ascending).
params.when_to_use: Find the top (or bottom) observations by wind speed, SST, or sea level pressure within the same year and geographical 10°/1° box partition. | Filter to high-ranked observations (e.g., rank = 1 or rank <= N) within year+box for downstream event/summary analysis. | Join observation-level attributes (callsign, deck, lat/lon, month) to other tables while preserving one-row-per-original-observation semantics. | Build aggregates of top-N observations per box/year by first selecting rows from this view (e.g., WHERE rank_by_wind_speed_desc <= N) and then re-aggregating.
params.output_schema: year: Observation year (directly from base column `year` in the source table). | month: Observation month (directly from base column `month` in the source table). | ten_degree_box_number: 10-degree box identifier containing the observation (directly from base column `ten_degree_box_number`). | one_degree_box_number: 1-degree box identifier containing the observation (directly from base column `one_degree_box_number`). | latitude: Observation latitude in decimal degrees (directly from base column `latitude`). | longitude: Observation longitude in decimal degrees (directly from base column `longitude`). | callsign: Ship/observer callsign identifier for the observation (directly from base column `callsign`). | deck: Deck/platform identifier or code associated with the observation (directly from base column `deck`). | wind_speed_m_s: Wind speed converted to meters per second = SAFE_DIVIDE(wind_speed, 10.0) where `wind_speed` is the integer/packed value in source table `wind_speed`. | sea_surface_temp_c: Sea surface temperature in degrees Celsius = SAFE_DIVIDE(sea_surface_temp, 10.0) where `sea_surface_temp` is the integer/packed value in source table `sea_surface_temp`. | sea_level_pressure_hpa: Sea level pressure in hectopascals = SAFE_DIVIDE(sea_level_pressure, 10.0) where `sea_level_pressure` is the integer/packed value in source table `sea_level_pressure`. | rank_by_wind_speed_desc: Rank() of the observation within the partition (year, ten_degree_box_number, one_degree_box_number) ordering by wind_speed_m_s descending (NULLs last). Equal values receive the same rank and gaps can occur (standard RANK()). | rank_by_sst_desc: Rank() of the observation within the partition (year, ten_degree_box_number, one_degree_box_number) ordering by sea_surface_temp_c descending (NULLs last). | rank_by_slp_asc: Rank() of the observation within the partition (year, ten_degree_box_number, one_degree_box_number) ordering by sea_level_pressure_hpa ascending (NULLs last).
params.metric: wind_speed_m_s = SAFE_DIVIDE(bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2001_2004.wind_speed, 10.0) | sea_surface_temp_c = SAFE_DIVIDE(bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2001_2004.sea_surface_temp, 10.0) | sea_level_pressure_hpa = SAFE_DIVIDE(bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2001_2004.sea_level_pressure, 10.0) | rank_by_wind_speed_desc = RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY year, ten_degree_box_number, one_degree_box_number ORDER BY wind_speed_m_s DESC NULLS LAST) | rank_by_sst_desc = RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY year, ten_degree_box_number, one_degree_box_number ORDER BY sea_surface_temp_c DESC NULLS LAST) | rank_by_slp_asc = RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY year, ten_degree_box_number, one_degree_box_number ORDER BY sea_level_pressure_hpa ASC NULLS LAST)
params.composition: cardinality-SAFE join guidance: join to dimension tables that are one-row-per-key (or can be aggregated to one row) on keys {year, ten_degree_box_number, one_degree_box_number} or on observation-level identifiers (e.g., callsign + year + month) — safe because this view is one-row-per-original-observation. Examples of safe joins: |  - Join to a stations_dim (or other single-row station metadata) on callsign (or station id) — safe because stations_dim should be one row per station; joining adds attributes without duplicating observations' measures. |  - Join to a view keyed one-to-one with the original observation (for example icoads_core_sel_basic_obs if it preserves one-row-per-original-observation and shares the same primary key) — safe because keys align 1:1. | Do NOT naively join this view to one-to-many tables or views (for example: multiple event reports per observation, sequences or windows that produce many rows per observation like *_WIN, or any detailed measurement unpivot that expands rows) without re-aggregation, because such joins will multiply rows and therefore duplicate/overcount measures derived from single observations. Specific NOT-SAFE examples: |  - Do NOT join directly to any *_WIN (windowed) views (e.g., icoads_obs_by_callsign_sequences_win, icoads_ship_observation_sequences_win) without aggregating the windowed side to one row per observation first — those views produce multiple rows per observation/time and will multiply counts/sums based on this view's rows. |  - Do NOT join directly to reshape/unpivot outputs (e.g., icoads_measures_unpivot_reshape, agency_measure_unpivot_reshape) which expand measures into multiple rows per observation, unless you first re-aggregate (e.g., count/distinct or MAX) so the join is 1:1. |  - Do NOT join to aggregate views keyed at a coarser grain (e.g., icoads_monthly_agg_per_box, icoads_monthly_agg_per_box_dynamic, seasonal_storm_summary_agg) expecting the aggregate to remain correct unless you aggregate this view to the same grain first — joining a coarser aggregate to these observation rows will duplicate the aggregate when performing sums/counts. | Recommended composition patterns: |  - Filter-then-aggregate: to compute metrics like number of top-N observations per box-year, first SELECT from this view WHERE rank_by_wind_speed_desc <= N and then GROUP BY the desired keys to aggregate; this prevents double-counting and preserves intended semantics. |  - Join for enrichment only on true 1:1 keys: if a dimension/view is guaranteed to be one-row-per-callsign (or per observation id), it can be joined directly. Otherwise, reduce the many-side to one row per join-key before joining (e.g., use MAX/ANY_VALUE or GROUP BY). |  - When composing further rank/window measures, keep the same granular partitioning (year + box identifiers) or explicitly reduce this view to the target partition/grain before computing new window functions to avoid unintended ties/duplicates.

icoads_top_observations_rank_by_box.description: Assigns ranks within each partition (year + ten_degree_box_number + one_degree_box_number) for high/low values of common measures: descending wind speed, descending SST, ascending sea level pressure. Exposes rank columns for downstream Top-K filtering. | Use for: Select top-K highest-wind or highest-SST observations per spatial cell; Identify lowest pressure observations per cell (possible storm indicators)

icoads_measures_unpivot_reshape.name: icoads_measures_unpivot_reshape
icoads_measures_unpivot_reshape.body_sql:
SELECT
  year,
  month,
  day,
  hour,
  latitude,
  longitude,
  callsign,
  deck,
  CONCAT('wind_speed_m_s') AS measure_name,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(wind_speed, 10.0) AS measure_value,
  'm/s' AS measure_unit
FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_1662_2000`
WHERE wind_speed IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT
  year,
  month,
  day,
  hour,
  latitude,
  longitude,
  callsign,
  deck,
  'sea_surface_temp_c' AS measure_name,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(sea_surface_temp, 10.0) AS measure_value,
  'degC' AS measure_unit
FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_1662_2000`
WHERE sea_surface_temp IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT
  year,
  month,
  day,
  hour,
  latitude,
  longitude,
  callsign,
  deck,
  'sea_level_pressure_hpa' AS measure_name,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(sea_level_pressure, 10.0) AS measure_value,
  'hPa' AS measure_unit
FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_1662_2000`
WHERE sea_level_pressure IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT
  year,
  month,
  day,
  hour,
  latitude,
  longitude,
  callsign,
  deck,
  'air_temperature_c' AS measure_name,
  air_temperature AS measure_value,
  'degC' AS measure_unit
FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_1662_2000`
WHERE air_temperature IS NOT NULL
grain: one row per original observation per measure (unpivoted)

params.description: Provides a tall (unpivoted) set of individual ICOADS observations, one row per original observation per measured variable (wind speed, sea surface temp, sea level pressure, air temperature) with standardized value and unit.
params.when_to_use: List or filter individual ICOADS measurements (e.g., all wind_speed_m_s observations in July 1880). | Time-series or spatial extracts built from original observations after filtering by measure_name and/or callsign, deck, date components, or location. | Composing aggregations over specific measures (e.g., average sea_surface_temp_c by month) — use this view as the measure-level input and then aggregate. | Joining to station or voyage metadata on callsign/latitude/longitude/date to enrich individual measurement rows (see composition guidance).
params.output_schema: year: calendar year of the original observation (derived from bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_1662_2000.year) | month: calendar month of the original observation (derived from bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_1662_2000.month) | day: calendar day of the original observation (derived from bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_1662_2000.day) | hour: hour of the original observation (derived from bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_1662_2000.hour) | latitude: observation latitude in degrees (derived from bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_1662_2000.latitude) | longitude: observation longitude in degrees (derived from bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_1662_2000.longitude) | callsign: vessel/station callsign identifying the reporting source (derived from bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_1662_2000.callsign) | deck: ICOADS deck/source code for the observation (derived from bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_1662_2000.deck) | measure_name: canonical unpivoted measurement name (one of 'wind_speed_m_s','sea_surface_temp_c','sea_level_pressure_hpa','air_temperature_c'; assigned in each SELECT branch) | measure_value: numeric value standardized/scaled for the measure (see metric definitions below; derived from source columns with SAFE_DIVIDE scaling where applied) | measure_unit: unit string for measure_value (one of 'm/s','degC','hPa') as assigned in each SELECT branch
params.metric: wind_speed_m_s = SAFE_DIVIDE(bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_1662_2000.wind_speed, 10.0)  -- units: m/s (rows included only where wind_speed IS NOT NULL) | sea_surface_temp_c = SAFE_DIVIDE(bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_1662_2000.sea_surface_temp, 10.0)  -- units: degC (rows included only where sea_surface_temp IS NOT NULL) | sea_level_pressure_hpa = SAFE_DIVIDE(bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_1662_2000.sea_level_pressure, 10.0)  -- units: hPa (rows included only where sea_level_pressure IS NOT NULL) | air_temperature_c = bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_1662_2000.air_temperature  -- units: degC (rows included only where air_temperature IS NOT NULL)
params.composition: cardinality-SAFE join guidance: join to dimension tables or views keyed 1:1 with the observation-level keys without multiplying rows. Examples of safe joins: |  - Join to stations_dim on callsign (JOIN stations_dim USING (callsign)) — safe if stations_dim has at most one row per callsign. This will not duplicate measures because the view is one-row-per-original-observation and stations_dim is expected to be one-row-per-callsign. |  - Join to icoads_core_sel_basic_obs (SEL) or icoads_core_events_sel (SEL) on (year,month,day,hour,latitude,longitude,callsign,deck) only if those views are strictly unique per original observation; verify their uniqueness before joining to avoid duplication. | do NOT join without aggregation to known one-to-many siblings that expand an observation into multiple rows, because that will multiply measures and invalidate aggregations. Examples of joins to avoid (unless you aggregate first): |  - Do NOT join directly to any *_AGG, *_RANK, *_WIN, *_SET, or other aggregate/rolling/window result that may contain multiple rows per underlying observation (e.g., icoads_monthly_agg_per_box, icoads_top_observations_rank, icoads_observation_counts_by_country, icoads_monthly_agg_per_box_dynamic, icoads_ship_observation_sequences_win). Those are one-to-many relative to individual measurement rows and will duplicate this view's measures. |  - Do NOT join directly to normalized event or sequence views that contain multiple event rows per observation (e.g., icoads_obs_by_callsign_sequences_win, icoads_ship_observation_sequences_win) without re-aggregating the joined side to a single row per observation key. | Safe composition patterns: |  - Filter by measure_name then aggregate measure_value (e.g., AVG(measure_value) GROUP BY year, month) to compute per-time or per-space summaries. |  - If enriching with a table that is many-to-one (many enriched rows per observation), first aggregate the enrichment to one row per observation key (e.g., SELECT callsign, MIN(some_flag) ... GROUP BY callsign) and then join. |  - If you need to combine multiple measure types per original observation into wide form, pivot measure_name back into columns by grouping on the original observation keys (year,month,day,hour,latitude,longitude,callsign,deck) and using aggregated CASE expressions to avoid row explosion.

icoads_measures_unpivot_reshape.description: Unpivots several key numeric measures (wind, SST, pressure, air temp) into a measure-name / measure-value table so multi-measure analyses, faceting, or standardized plotting are simpler. | Use for: Plot multi-measure time series for given location or callsign; Aggregate/count measures by name (e.g., how many SST vs wind observations); Apply common QC rules across measures

icoads_monthly_agg_per_box_dynamic.name: icoads_monthly_agg_per_box_dynamic
icoads_monthly_agg_per_box_dynamic.body_sql:
SELECT
  year,
  month,
  ten_degree_box_number,
  one_degree_box_number,
  COUNT(*) AS obs_count,
  COUNTIF(wind_speed IS NOT NULL) AS cnt_wind_speed,
  CASE WHEN COUNTIF(wind_speed IS NOT NULL)=0 THEN NULL ELSE AVG(SAFE_DIVIDE(wind_speed, 10.0)) END AS avg_wind_speed_m_s,
  MIN(SAFE_DIVIDE(wind_speed, 10.0)) AS min_wind_speed_m_s,
  MAX(SAFE_DIVIDE(wind_speed, 10.0)) AS max_wind_speed_m_s,
  COUNTIF(sea_surface_temp IS NOT NULL) AS cnt_sst,
  CASE WHEN COUNTIF(sea_surface_temp IS NOT NULL)=0 THEN NULL ELSE AVG(SAFE_DIVIDE(sea_surface_temp, 10.0)) END AS avg_sst_c,
  MIN(SAFE_DIVIDE(sea_surface_temp, 10.0)) AS min_sst_c,
  MAX(SAFE_DIVIDE(sea_surface_temp, 10.0)) AS max_sst_c,
  COUNTIF(sea_level_pressure IS NOT NULL) AS cnt_sea_level_pressure,
  CASE WHEN COUNTIF(sea_level_pressure IS NOT NULL)=0 THEN NULL ELSE AVG(SAFE_DIVIDE(sea_level_pressure, 10.0)) END AS avg_sea_level_pressure_hpa,
  MIN(SAFE_DIVIDE(sea_level_pressure, 10.0)) AS min_sea_level_pressure_hpa,
  MAX(SAFE_DIVIDE(sea_level_pressure, 10.0)) AS max_sea_level_pressure_hpa
FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_1662_2000`
GROUP BY year, month, ten_degree_box_number, one_degree_box_number

params.description: Monthly, 10°-box and 1°-box level aggregates of ICOADS observations: counts and basic stats (count, avg, min, max) for wind speed, sea surface temperature, and sea level pressure, plus total observation count, grouped by year and month.
params.when_to_use: Get monthly summary statistics of ICOADS observations inside geographic boxes at the granularity of ten_degree_box_number + one_degree_box_number. | Compare observation densities and average conditions (wind, SST, SLP) across months or boxes. | Use as a pre-aggregated layer to build higher-level monthly or regional aggregates without re-scanning raw ICOADS rows. | Join to spatial or box-dimension tables to add geometry/labels (but preserve cardinality guidance below).
params.output_schema: year: calendar year of the observation group, from icoads_core_1662_2000.year | month: calendar month (1-12) of the observation group, from icoads_core_1662_2000.month | ten_degree_box_number: coarse 10-degree box identifier used in the source table, from icoads_core_1662_2000.ten_degree_box_number | one_degree_box_number: 1-degree box identifier within the 10-degree box (finer spatial bin), from icoads_core_1662_2000.one_degree_box_number | obs_count: COUNT(*) of raw ICOADS rows in this (year, month, ten_degree_box_number, one_degree_box_number) group (source: COUNT(*) over icoads_core_1662_2000 rows) | cnt_wind_speed: number of rows with non-null wind_speed in the group (source: COUNTIF(wind_speed IS NOT NULL)) | avg_wind_speed_m_s: average wind_speed in m/s (source: AVG(SAFE_DIVIDE(wind_speed, 10.0)) computed only when cnt_wind_speed>0); wind_speed in source is integer scaled by 10 | min_wind_speed_m_s: minimum wind_speed in m/s for the group (source: MIN(SAFE_DIVIDE(wind_speed, 10.0))) | max_wind_speed_m_s: maximum wind_speed in m/s for the group (source: MAX(SAFE_DIVIDE(wind_speed, 10.0))) | cnt_sst: number of rows with non-null sea_surface_temp in the group (source: COUNTIF(sea_surface_temp IS NOT NULL)) | avg_sst_c: average sea_surface_temp in °C (source: AVG(SAFE_DIVIDE(sea_surface_temp, 10.0)) computed only when cnt_sst>0); sea_surface_temp in source is scaled by 10 | min_sst_c: minimum sea_surface_temp in °C for the group (source: MIN(SAFE_DIVIDE(sea_surface_temp, 10.0))) | max_sst_c: maximum sea_surface_temp in °C for the group (source: MAX(SAFE_DIVIDE(sea_surface_temp, 10.0))) | cnt_sea_level_pressure: number of rows with non-null sea_level_pressure in the group (source: COUNTIF(sea_level_pressure IS NOT NULL)) | avg_sea_level_pressure_hpa: average sea_level_pressure in hPa (source: AVG(SAFE_DIVIDE(sea_level_pressure, 10.0)) computed only when cnt_sea_level_pressure>0); Multiplying joins would require recomputing counts/averages from raw measures or dividing by counts which is error-prone. | when composing higher-level metrics: to compute a regional average wind speed across multiple boxes, use sums of (avg * cnt) / sum(cnt) (i.e., weighted by cnt_wind_speed) rather than averaging avg_wind_speed_m_s directly; to compute region totals of observations, SUM(obs_count) is appropriate.

icoads_ship_observation_sequences_win.name: icoads_ship_observation_sequences_win
icoads_ship_observation_sequences_win.body_sql:
SELECT
  NULL AS table_suffix,
  callsign,
  year,
  month,
  day,
  hour,
  TIMESTAMP(
    FORMAT(
      '%04d-%02d-%02d %02d:%02d:%02d',
      COALESCE(year,0),
      COALESCE(month,0),
      COALESCE(day,0),
      CAST(FLOOR(COALESCE(hour,0)) AS INT64),
      CAST(FLOOR((COALESCE(hour,0) - FLOOR(COALESCE(hour,0))) * 60) AS INT64),
      CAST(FLOOR((COALESCE(hour,0) - FLOOR(COALESCE(hour,0))) * 3600) AS INT64)
    )
  ) AS obs_timestamp_approx,
  latitude,
  longitude,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(wind_speed, 10.0) AS wind_speed_m_s,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(sea_surface_temp, 10.0) AS sea_surface_temp_c,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(sea_level_pressure, 10.0) AS sea_level_pressure_hpa,
  LAG(
    TIMESTAMP(
      FORMAT(
        '%04d-%02d-%02d %02d:%02d:%02d',
        COALESCE(year,0),
        COALESCE(month,0),
        COALESCE(day,0),
        CAST(FLOOR(COALESCE(hour,0)) AS INT64),
        CAST(FLOOR((COALESCE(hour,0) - FLOOR(COALESCE(hour,0))) * 60) AS INT64),
        CAST(FLOOR((COALESCE(hour,0) - FLOOR(COALESCE(hour,0))) * 3600) AS INT64)
      )
    )
  ) OVER (PARTITION BY callsign ORDER BY year, month, day, hour) AS prev_obs_timestamp_approx,
  TIMESTAMP_DIFF(
    TIMESTAMP(
      FORMAT(
        '%04d-%02d-%02d %02d:%02d:%02d',
        COALESCE(year,0),
        COALESCE(month,0),
        COALESCE(day,0),
        CAST(FLOOR(COALESCE(hour,0)) AS INT64),
        CAST(FLOOR((COALESCE(hour,0) - FLOOR(COALESCE(hour,0))) * 60) AS INT64),
        CAST(FLOOR((COALESCE(hour,0) - FLOOR(COALESCE(hour,0))) * 3600) AS INT64)
      )
    ),
    LAG(
      TIMESTAMP(
        FORMAT(
          '%04d-%02d-%02d %02d:%02d:%02d',
          COALESCE(year,0),
          COALESCE(month,0),
          COALESCE(day,0),
          CAST(FLOOR(COALESCE(hour,0)) AS INT64),
          CAST(FLOOR((COALESCE(hour,0) - FLOOR(COALESCE(hour,0))) * 60) AS INT64),
          CAST(FLOOR((COALESCE(hour,0) - FLOOR(COALESCE(hour,0))) * 3600) AS INT64)
        )
      )
    ) OVER (PARTITION BY callsign ORDER BY year, month, day, hour),
    SECOND
  ) AS seconds_since_prev_approx,
  latitude - LAG(latitude) OVER (PARTITION BY callsign ORDER BY year, month, day, hour) AS delta_lat_deg,
  longitude - LAG(longitude) OVER (PARTITION BY callsign ORDER BY year, month, day, hour) AS delta_lon_deg,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(wind_speed,10.0) - LAG(SAFE_DIVIDE(wind_speed,10.0)) OVER (PARTITION BY callsign ORDER BY year, month, day, hour) AS delta_wind_speed_m_s,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(sea_surface_temp,10.0) - LAG(SAFE_DIVIDE(sea_surface_temp,10.0)) OVER (PARTITION BY callsign ORDER BY year, month, day, hour) AS delta_sst_c
FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_1662_2000`
grain: one row per observation for each callsign with windowed differences to previous observation of same callsign

params.description: Provides one row per ICOADS observation per callsign with an approximate timestamp and windowed differences to the previous observation for the same callsign (time difference and deltas for latitude, longitude, wind speed, sea surface temperature, and sea level pressure).
params.when_to_use: Compute vessel/observer movement or environmental change between consecutive ICOADS observations for the same callsign (e.g., speed/heading estimation from delta lat/lon, change in wind or SST over time). | As a base for time-series analyses per callsign where you need the previous-observation context (seconds since previous observation, previous observation timestamp). | Filtering or anomaly detection that requires both current and immediately-previous observation values (e.g., sudden jump in position or measurement). | Composing further aggregations (e.g., average seconds-between-observations per callsign, distribution of deltas) by grouping this view's rows.
params.output_schema: table_suffix: placeholder column; set to NULL in this view (NULL literal in SELECT). | callsign: callsign of the observation (sourced from base column callsign). | year: observation year integer (sourced from base column year). | month: observation month integer (sourced from base column month). | day: observation day integer (sourced from base column day). | hour: observation hour as fractional hours (sourced from base column hour). | obs_timestamp_approx: approximate TIMESTAMP constructed from year, month, day, hour (derived from FORMAT(...) and TIMESTAMP(...)). | latitude: observation latitude (sourced from base column latitude). | longitude: observation longitude (sourced from base column longitude). | wind_speed_m_s: wind_speed divided by 10.0 to convert stored integer to m/s (derived from SAFE_DIVIDE(wind_speed, 10.0)). | sea_surface_temp_c: sea_surface_temp divided by 10.0 to convert stored integer to degrees C (derived from SAFE_DIVIDE(sea_surface_temp, 10.0)). | sea_level_pressure_hpa: sea_level_pressure divided by 10.0 to convert stored integer to hPa (derived from SAFE_DIVIDE(sea_level_pressure, 10.0)). | prev_obs_timestamp_approx: the previous obs_timestamp_approx for the same callsign using LAG() OVER (PARTITION BY callsign ORDER BY year, month, day, hour) (derived TIMESTAMP similar to obs_timestamp_approx). | seconds_since_prev_approx: TIMESTAMP_DIFF between obs_timestamp_approx and prev_obs_timestamp_approx in seconds (derived using TIMESTAMP_DIFF). | delta_lat_deg: difference in latitude between current and previous observation for same callsign (latitude - previous latitude; implemented implicitly by comparing current latitude to the row returned by the partitioned lag — in this view the explicit expression is present as delta_lat_deg). | delta_lon_deg: difference in longitude between current and previous observation for same callsign (longitude - previous longitude). | delta_wind_speed_m_s: difference in wind_speed_m_s between current and previous observation for same callsign (wind_speed_m_s - previous wind_speed_m_s). | delta_sst_c: difference in sea_surface_temp_c between current and previous observation for same callsign (sea_surface_temp_c - previous sea_surface_temp_c).
params.grounded_columns: callsign | year | month | day | hour | latitude | longitude | wind_speed | sea_surface_temp | sea_level_pressure
params.metric: obs_timestamp_approx = TIMESTAMP(FORMAT('%04d-%02d-%02d %02d:%02d:%02d', COALESCE(year,0), COALESCE(month,0), COALESCE(day,0), CAST(FLOOR(COALESCE(hour,0)) AS INT64), CAST(FLOOR((COALESCE(hour,0) - FLOOR(COALESCE(hour,0))) * 60) AS INT64), CAST(FLOOR((COALESCE(hour,0) - FLOOR(COALESCE(hour,0))) * 3600) AS INT64))) | wind_speed_m_s = SAFE_DIVIDE(wind_speed, 10.0) | sea_surface_temp_c = SAFE_DIVIDE(sea_surface_temp, 10.0) | sea_level_pressure_hpa = SAFE_DIVIDE(sea_level_pressure, 10.0) | prev_obs_timestamp_approx = LAG(obs_timestamp_approx) OVER (PARTITION BY callsign ORDER BY year, month, day, hour)  -- implemented in SQL by repeating the TIMESTAMP(...) expression inside LAG() | seconds_since_prev_approx = TIMESTAMP_DIFF(obs_timestamp_approx, prev_obs_timestamp_approx, SECOND) | delta_lat_deg = latitude - LAG(latitude) OVER (PARTITION BY callsign ORDER BY year, month, day, hour) | delta_lon_deg = longitude - LAG(longitude) OVER (PARTITION BY callsign ORDER BY year, month, day, hour) | delta_wind_speed_m_s = wind_speed_m_s - LAG(wind_speed_m_s) OVER (PARTITION BY callsign ORDER BY year, month, day, hour) | delta_sst_c = sea_surface_temp_c - LAG(sea_surface_temp_c) OVER (PARTITION BY callsign ORDER BY year, month, day, hour)
params.composition: cardinality-SAFE join guidance: join to a dimension or lookup that is one-row-per-callsign (or one-row-per-callsign-per-time if keys include time) on corresponding key(s) — safe because this view is one-row-per-observation-per-callsign so joining a one-row-per-callsign dimension will not multiply rows. Example: JOIN to a callsign-to-vessel_dim on callsign (safe because vessel_dim must be one row per callsign). | Do NOT join directly to any table or view that is one-to-many relative to this view's row identity (one observation row) without first aggregating or deduplicating the other side. For example, do NOT join to a raw observations table or any events table that can contain multiple rows per callsign+timestamp unless you aggregate those rows first; doing so will multiply this view's rows and duplicate the windowed deltas/seconds measures. | If you need to enrich with many-to-one relationships keyed by (callsign, obs_timestamp_approx) where the enrichment side can contain multiple rows (e.g., sensor_readings with multiple channels at same timestamp), first aggregate sensor_readings to one row per callsign+timestamp (e.g., MAX or SUM) and then join — this preserves the intended cardinality and prevents measure duplication. | When composing upward aggregations from this view (e.g., average seconds_between_obs per callsign), aggregate this view's numeric measures after join or before joining wider one-to-many tables so you avoid accidental multiplication of intervals/deltas. | This view's window functions partition by callsign and order by year, month, day, hour; any join that changes or expands the set of rows per callsign (for example adding multiple matching rows for the same observation timestamp) will change the logical 'previous' relation if done before recomputing windows — to preserve correct prev_obs relations, compute windows in this view and then join externally (i.e., treat this view as canonical for prev/delta calculations).

icoads_ship_observation_sequences_win.description: Windowed sequence per callsign computing previous-observation differences (time and spatial deltas) and deltas for key measures. Useful for track analysis, speed/movement estimation, and per-ship temporal consistency checks. | Use for: Estimate ship movement speed/direction between successive observations; Detect abrupt changes in measured variables per callsign; Filter sequences by minimum seconds_since_prev or by magnitude of deltas

params.description: Provides one-row-per-acoustic-file metadata (from noaa_passive_acoustic_index.nrs_metadata) including identifiers, spatial location, temporal start, sensor and sampling properties, and a file link.
params.when_to_use: Look up metadata for a specific acoustic file (filename, deployment, start date/time, location, depth, sample rate, duration, link). | Filter or map acoustic files by location (lat/lon/point_geom) or deployment for downstream analysis. | Join file-level metadata to derived-per-file measures (e.g., detection summaries, acoustic indices) as a dimension table. | Aggregate or time-filter files (by start_date, duration, project, organization) before computing further summary statistics. | Build spatial queries (e.g., bounding-box or point-in-polygon) using point_geom or latitude/longitude to select files for analysis.
params.output_schema: file_name: file_name from nrs_metadata.file_name — unique identifier for the acoustic file (one row per file). | deployment_name: deployment_name from nrs_metadata.deployment_name — name of the deployment associated with the file. | start_date: SAFE_CAST(start_date AS DATE) from nrs_metadata.start_date — calendar date when recording started (cast to DATE). | start_time: start_time from nrs_metadata.start_time — recorded time-of-day string/field for file start (no casting applied). | source_organization: source_organization from nrs_metadata.source_organization — organization that provided or collected the file. | funding_organization: funding_organization from nrs_metadata.funding_organization — funding organization associated with the file/project. | project_name: project_name from nrs_metadata.project_name — project under which the file was recorded. | sensor_depth_m: SAFE_CAST(sensor_depth AS INT64) from nrs_metadata.sensor_depth — sensor depth in meters (cast to integer). | sample_rate_hz: SAFE_CAST(sample_rate AS INT64) from nrs_metadata.sample_rate — sample rate in Hz (cast to integer). | duration_s: SAFE_CAST(duration AS INT64) from nrs_metadata.duration — duration of the file in seconds (cast to integer). | platform_name: platform_name from nrs_metadata.platform_name — platform or vessel name used for the deployment/file. | longitude: SAFE_CAST(lon AS FLOAT64) from nrs_metadata.lon — longitude of recording location (cast to float). | latitude: SAFE_CAST(lat AS FLOAT64) from nrs_metadata.lat — latitude of recording location (cast to float). | point_geom: point_geom from nrs_metadata.point_geom — geography/geometry point object for the recording location (if present). | file_link: file_link from nrs_metadata.file_link — external or storage link/URI to the acoustic file.
params.metric: sensor_depth_m = SAFE_CAST(nrs_metadata.sensor_depth AS INT64) | sample_rate_hz = SAFE_CAST(nrs_metadata.sample_rate AS INT64) | duration_s = SAFE_CAST(nrs_metadata.duration AS INT64) | start_date = SAFE_CAST(nrs_metadata.start_date AS DATE) | longitude = SAFE_CAST(nrs_metadata.lon AS FLOAT64) | latitude = SAFE_CAST(nrs_metadata.lat AS FLOAT64)
params.composition: cardinality-SAFE join guidance: join to per-file or per-deployment dimensions keyed by file_name or deployment_name — e.g., join to another one-row-per-file view on file_name is safe because this view is explicitly one-row-per-file (grain = file_name) so measures are not duplicated. | Safe example: JOIN <file-level-measures> ON passive_acoustic_files_core_nrs.file_name = file_level_measures.file_name — safe because both sides are one-row-per-file. | Safe example: JOIN deployments_dim ON passive_acoustic_files_core_nrs.deployment_name = deployments_dim.deployment_name — safe if deployments_dim is one-row-per-deployment (one-to-one or many-files-to-one-deployment direction is allowed because this view remains at file grain). | Do NOT join without aggregation to one-to-many tables (e.g., detection events, per-file-segment measures, or any table that has multiple rows per file) directly on file_name unless you first aggregate the many-side to one row per file (e.g., COUNT(*), SUM(...), AVG(...), or other aggregates grouped by file_name). Otherwise the file-level rows and their measures (duration_s, sample_rate_hz, etc.) will be duplicated/multiplied by the number of matching child rows. | If you need to attach many-row detail (e.g., detections, segments), either: (a) aggregate the detail to file_name before joining, or (b) keep the query at the detail grain and treat fields from this view as attributes (repeat per detail row) but avoid summing file-level metrics after such a join unless you re-aggregate correctly. | Spatial joins: joining to spatial polygons is safe for filtering (e.g., find files whose point_geom is within a polygon). However, if the polygon side is one-to-many (e.g., polygon partitions duplicated), ensure you de-duplicate polygons or aggregate join results to avoid multiplying file rows. | Null/key notes: file_name is the canonical grain key; if file_name is not unique in an external table you join to, resolve duplicates first (e.g., select distinct file_name) before joining to preserve cardinality.

SELECT

  SAFE_CAST(inline_depth AS FLOAT64) AS inline_depth_m,

FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_pifsc_metadata.dclde_lasker_array_depth`
grain: src_table, utc_time -- one row per time-depth sample

params.description: A normalized unioned view of time-depth samples from two PIFSC array depth source tables; one row per observed UTC time and depth sample with source table tag.
params.when_to_use: Querying or filtering individual time-depth samples (utc_time + depth) from the combined PIFSC array depth sources. | Joining time-depth samples to other event/track data by time (utc_time) or by exact depth for point-level spatial/time analyses. | Composing higher-level aggregations (e.g., counts of samples by day, depth ranges, or source) by aggregating this view's rows. | Building time series of sample counts, mean depths, or depth distributions per day/time window after appropriate aggregation.
params.output_schema: utc_time: UTC timestamp of the sample — derived directly from source column utc_time in each unioned source table. | local_time: Local time (as provided) corresponding to the sample — derived directly from source column local_time in each unioned source table. | inline_depth_m: Inline (start) depth in meters for the sample — SAFE_CAST(inline_depth AS FLOAT64) from source inline_depth. | end_depth_m: End (stop) depth in meters for the sample — SAFE_CAST(end_depth AS FLOAT64) from source end_depth. | src_table: Literal tag identifying which base source produced the row — set to 'dclde_sette_array_depth' or 'dclde_lasker_array_depth'.
params.metric: inline_depth_m = SAFE_CAST(inline_depth AS FLOAT64) | end_depth_m = SAFE_CAST(end_depth AS FLOAT64)
params.composition: cardinality-SAFE join guidance: join to date/day dimension or any true 1:1 lookup by utc_time (if you can guarantee unique utc_time keys) — safe because this view is one row per (src_table, utc_time, inline/end depth) sample; joining on utc_time alone is only safe if the dimension has unique utc_time values and you understand this view may have multiple rows for the same utc_time (different depths or sources). | Join to a station or track dimension on exact matching keys that are 1:1 with the view rows (for example, if you have a dimension keyed by (src_table, utc_time) and that dimension is 1:1) — safe because it will not duplicate rows when the dimension is strictly one row per the same key. | Do NOT join this view directly to any table or view that is one-to-many with respect to the view's grain (for example: any measurements unpivot/reshape that expands rows per sample, or event tables with multiple events per sample time) without re-aggregating first, because that will multiply this view's rows and therefore multiply counts/sums derived from it. | When composing aggregates: if you need counts, means, or sums of depths, aggregate this view first (GROUP BY src_table, DATE(utc_time), or other grouping keys) before joining to other one-to-many datasets to preserve correct measure semantics. | If joining to sibling normalized event/time series views (e.g., hurricane_track_points_core or pifsc_gps_tracks_combined), prefer joining on precise keys (utc_time and any available unique track/station identifiers). If the event/track view has multiple rows per utc_time, either aggregate that view to 1 row per utc_time or aggregate this view to a compatible grain to avoid duplication.

Useful for joining to GPS tracks or associating depth profiles with detections by time. | Use for: Time-series depth analysis of arrays; Join depth samples to GPS points by timestamp proximity; Derive dive profiles or depth histograms for arrays

pifsc_gps_tracks_combined.body_sql:
SELECT
  utc_time AS utc_time,
  local_time AS local_time,
  SAFE_CAST(latitude AS FLOAT64) AS latitude,

FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_pifsc_metadata.dclde_sette_gps`
UNION ALL
SELECT
  utc_time AS utc_time,
  local_time AS local_time,
  SAFE_CAST(latitude AS FLOAT64) AS latitude,
  SAFE_CAST(longitude AS FLOAT64) AS longitude,
  NULL AS point_geom,
  SAFE_CAST(speed AS FLOAT64) AS speed_m_s,
  SAFE_CAST(effort AS INT64) AS effort,
  'dclde_lasker_gps' AS src_table
FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_pifsc_metadata.dclde_lasker_gps`
grain: src_table, utc_time -- one row per GPS track point

params.description: A normalized, row-level union of GPS track points from two NOAA PIFSC source tables giving timestamped locations, speed, effort, and source table tag.
params.when_to_use: Retrieve time-ordered GPS track points (utc and local) for mapping or time-series analysis. | Compute distances, speeds, or trajectories by composing spatial functions on point_geom or latitude/longitude. | Filter or aggregate track points by time ranges, effort code, source table, or spatial bounds. | Join GPS points to other event or station tables by time and/or location (with attention to join cardinality).
params.output_schema: utc_time: event timestamp in UTC; sourced from the utc_time column of each base source table. | local_time: local timestamp (timezone-adjusted) corresponding to the utc_time; sourced from the local_time column of each base source table. | latitude: latitude in decimal degrees as FLOAT64; derived from SAFE_CAST(latitude AS FLOAT64) of each base source table. | longitude: longitude in decimal degrees as FLOAT64; derived from SAFE_CAST(longitude AS FLOAT64) of each base source table. | point_geom: geometry/point column (native typed column named point in the first source) — for dclde_sette_gps this is the point column; for dclde_lasker_gps this is NULL. | speed_m_s: speed in meters per second as FLOAT64; derived from SAFE_CAST(speed AS FLOAT64) of each base source table. | effort: effort code as INT64; derived from SAFE_CAST(effort AS INT64) of each base source table. | src_table: literal string identifying source table for the row; 'dclde_sette_gps' or 'dclde_lasker_gps' as injected in the UNION ALL.
params.metric: latitude = SAFE_CAST(source.latitude AS FLOAT64) | longitude = SAFE_CAST(source.longitude AS FLOAT64) | speed_m_s = SAFE_CAST(source.speed AS FLOAT64) | effort = SAFE_CAST(source.effort AS INT64) | point_geom = source.point  -- present only for dclde_sette_gps; NULL for dclde_lasker_gps | src_table = literal 'dclde_sette_gps' OR 'dclde_lasker_gps' depending on which source produced the row
params.composition: cardinality-SAFE: join to a one-row-per-entity dimension (example: a device or vessel dimension keyed by an identifier present on GPS points) on that entity key is safe because this view is one row per GPS point; joining a one-row-per-entity dimension will not duplicate GPS point measures. | do NOT join without aggregation to a one-to-many table (for example: another table that contains multiple event annotations per GPS point or multiple derived observations keyed only by time or spatial bin) because that would multiply rows and duplicate point-level measures like speed_m_s and effort. | when joining to spatial aggregates (e.g., grid or tile tables) that map many points to one grid cell, joining is safe for attributing the grid id to each point; but if you then aggregate measures by grid you must use aggregations (COUNT, AVG(speed_m_s), MIN/ MAX) on this view to avoid double-counting. | when composing higher-level aggregates (for example: trips, tracks, or per-vessel summaries), first GROUP BY the desired grouping keys (e.g., vessel_id, date) and compute aggregated metrics (COUNT(*) as point_count, AVG(speed_m_s) as avg_speed_m_s, MIN(utc_time) as start_time, MAX(utc_time) as end_time) from this view; do not rely on joins to downstream one-to-many tables to produce correct aggregates without re-aggregation. | explicit safe-join guidance examples: |   - Safe: JOIN pifsc_gps_tracks_combined AS g ON g.src_table = t.src_table AND g.vessel_id = t.vessel_id  -- safe if t is a one-row-per-vessel dimension keyed by vessel_id |   - Unsafe without re-aggregation: JOIN pifsc_gps_tracks_combined AS g ON TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(g.utc_time, HOUR) = agg.hour_bucket  -- if agg contains multiple rows per hour_bucket per other keys, aggregating g first by hour is required to avoid duplication |   - Safe for enrichment then aggregate: LEFT JOIN pifsc_gps_tracks_combined AS g ON ST_DWithin(g.point_geom, station.geom, 1000)  -- this attaches station info to points; when summarizing by station, use GROUP BY station and aggregates over g to avoid counting duplicates introduced by multiple station matches.

Preserves utc/local times and point geometry for spatial operations. Use for mapping effort, joining to sightings/detections by time/spatial proximity, or computing vessel movement metrics. | Use for: Compute vessel tracks and movement metrics; Join GPS points to sightings/detections by time/spatial proximity; Aggregate effort or speed statistics by date or region

params.description: One row per minke detection event with event times (UTC and local), geographic location (lat/lon) and a point geometry — used to locate, filter and count individual minke detection events.
params.when_to_use: List or map minke detection events in time and space (e.g., draw points on a map or filter by time window). | Filter detections by local or UTC start time ranges, latitude/longitude bounding boxes, or spatial predicates applied to point_geom. | Compute event-level aggregates after correctly re-aggregating (for example: counts of detections per day, per region, or per track). | As the event-level building block to join to spatial or temporal dimensions (but follow cardinality guidance below).
params.output_schema: detection_time_start_local: local start timestamp of the detection event; derived from column detection_time_start_local in bigquery-public-data.noaa_pifsc_metadata.dclde_2020_1705_minke_detections | detection_time_start_utc: start timestamp in UTC for the detection event; derived from detection_time_start_utc in bigquery-public-data.noaa_pifsc_metadata.dclde_2020_1705_minke_detections | detection_time_end_utc: end timestamp in UTC for the detection event; derived from detection_time_end_utc in bigquery-public-data.noaa_pifsc_metadata.dclde_2020_1705_minke_detections | latitude: detection event latitude (FLOAT64); SAFE_CAST(latitude AS FLOAT64) of latitude in bigquery-public-data.noaa_pifsc_metadata.dclde_2020_1705_minke_detections | longitude: detection event longitude (FLOAT64); SAFE_CAST(longitude AS FLOAT64) of longitude in bigquery-public-data.noaa_pifsc_metadata.dclde_2020_1705_minke_detections | point_geom: geometry point for the detection event (source column named point); derived from point in bigquery-public-data.noaa_pifsc_metadata.dclde_2020_1705_minke_detections
params.metric: This view is strictly event-level (no pre-aggregated summary measures). Metrics should be derived by aggregating rows of this view. Examples: | event_count = COUNT(*)  -- count of detection events in the selected set | distinct_locations = COUNT(DISTINCT STRUCT(latitude, longitude))  -- distinct coordinate pairs in the selected set | detections_per_day = COUNT(*) GROUP BY DATE(detection_time_start_utc)  -- daily counts by UTC date
params.composition: cardinality-SAFE join guidance: join to time or spatial dimension tables (e.g., a calendar/date dimension keyed by DATE(detection_time_start_utc) or spatial grid table keyed by a computed cell id) — safe because this view is one row per detection event and those dimensions are one-row-per-key, so joining preserves a one-to-one (or many detections to one dimension) relationship and does NOT duplicate event rows when the join is dimension-to-fact (fact = this view). | Join to pifsc_species_lookup_dim or other one-row lookup/dimension tables on exact keys (if you create a key column) is safe only if the lookup is strictly one-row-per-key. Because this view has no species or lookup key column in its SQL, do not assume such joins without adding a proper key in both sides. | Do NOT join this view directly to any table or view that is one-to-many from detections (for example: any tracks, sequences, or observation-aggregation tables that contain multiple rows per detection event) without re-aggregating the many-side to one row per detection first. Such joins will multiply this view's rows and thus duplicate counts/metrics. | Examples of unsafe joins without re-aggregation: joining to a track-segment table where multiple segments overlap the same detection event, or joining to an observations table with multiple measurements per detection — these will inflate event_count and other aggregates unless you first aggregate the joining side to a single row per detection (for example, by grouping by a detection identifier or by DATE/time and location with appropriate aggregation). | Practical recommendation for composition: treat this view as the canonical event/fact table. If you need counts per other entities (track, vessel, station), either (a) aggregate this view to the entity key first (e.g., GROUP BY track_id after assigning track_id to detections via a spatial/temporal assignment step), or (b) aggregate the other table to one row per detection before joining so that joins remain cardinality-safe.

Use for temporal/spatial overlap analysis with sightings and tracks or to compute detection densities. | Use for: Temporal overlap of minke detections with other events; Spatial density mapping of minke detections; Associating detections with nearest GPS track points

If you need aggregated results by species after such a join, re-aggregate (e.g., GROUP BY pifsc_species_lookup_dim.species_code) to restore one-row-per-species aggregation. | When composing with other one-row-per-key dimensions (e.g., station or event dims that are one-row-per-station/event), joining on unrelated keys is safe because neither side will multiplicatively duplicate the other's rows. Any numeric aggregations must be computed from the fact tables (observations) after joining to this lookup and should use explicit aggregation (SUM/COUNT/AVG) with appropriate GROUP BY.

earthquakes_core_events_sel.name: earthquakes_core_events_sel
earthquakes_core_events_sel.body_sql:
SELECT
  id,
  year,
  month,
  day,
  hour,
  minute,
  second,
  -- construct an approximate UTC timestamp when year is valid; NULL if components missing
  SAFE.PARSE_TIMESTAMP('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%E*S', 
    CONCAT(CASE WHEN year IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(year AS STRING) ELSE '' END, '-',
           LPAD(CASE WHEN month IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(month AS STRING) ELSE '01' END, 2, '0'), '-',
           LPAD(CASE WHEN day IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(day AS STRING) ELSE '01' END, 2, '0'), ' ',
           LPAD(CASE WHEN hour IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(hour AS STRING) ELSE '00' END, 2, '0'), ':',
           LPAD(CASE WHEN minute IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(minute AS STRING) ELSE '00' END, 2, '0'), ':',
           COALESCE(CAST(second AS STRING), '00'))
  ) AS event_timestamp_utc,
  flag_tsunami,
  focal_depth,
  eq_primary,
  eq_mag_mw,
  eq_mag_ms,
  eq_mag_mb,
  eq_mag_ml,
  eq_mag_mfa,
  eq_mag_unk,
  intensity,
  country,
  state,
  location_name,
  latitude,
  longitude,
  region_code,
  deaths,
  missing,
  injuries,
  damage_millions_dollars,
  houses_destroyed,
  houses_damaged,
  total_deaths,
  total_missing,
  total_injuries,
  total_damage_millions_dollars,
  total_houses_destroyed,
  deaths_description,
  missing_description,
  injuries_description,
  damage_description,
  houses_destroyed_description,
  houses_damaged_description,
  total_deaths_description,

FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_significant_earthquakes.earthquakes`
